name: q3-graph
script: document.getElementById('demo-ribbon')?.remove(); (async () => { const r = await fetch('/api/devices/2').then(x => x.json()); const e = r.entities.find(x => x.name === 'Gi1/0/1'); if (!e) throw new Error('core-sw Gi1/0/1 not found'); location.hash = '#/device/2/entity/' + e.id; })()

name: q4-wizard
script: document.getElementById('demo-ribbon')?.remove(); (() => { const s = document.createElement('style'); s.textContent = 'dialog[open]{position:fixed;inset:0;margin:auto;}'; document.head.appendChild(s); document.getElementById('add-btn').click(); document.getElementById('f-host').value = '10.20.30.11'; document.getElementById('probe-btn').click(); })()
